core_obligations: By the pull-pseudo-coherent lemma the derived base change K tensor_A^L A' is pseudo-coherent over A' (proof lines 22030-22032). By the base-change comparison lemma, K tensor_A^L A' equals K tensor_R^L R' when viewed in D(R') (proof lines 22033-22034). Since K is R-perfect it has finite tor dimension over R, and the pull-tor-amplitude lemma gives that K tensor_R^L R' has finite tor dimension over R'; the two halves give that K tensor_A^L A' is R'-perfect (proof lines 22035-22037).
proof_roadmap: Get pseudo-coherence of the base change (proof lines 22030-22032).
Identify the object over R' and conclude finite tor dimension (proof lines 22033-22037).
